title: Simulated positive outcome for electrically-assisted SCOBY electrosynthesis
purpose: Generate a falsifiable positive-outcome reference scenario for later comparison against real experimental measurements.
simulated_structural_signatures: preferential fibril orientation along the electric-field axis
stronger orientation signature at 3.0 V than at 1.5 V
possible increased local density near anode
simulated_observations_during_growth: 1.5 V branch: minimal visible electrolysis and relatively uniform pellicle formation
3.0 V branch: visible gas evolution near electrodes and possible cathodic growth suppression

simulated_characterization.XRD: simulated increased orientation-sensitive reflection intensity consistent with fibril alignment along the field axis
simulated_characterization.SEM: simulated elongated fibril bundles preferentially oriented along the anode-cathode axis
simulated_characterization.interpretation: simulation-only structural signatures; no instrument data exist

interpretation.mechanistic_interpretation: The simulated dataset is consistent with field-induced anisotropic organization of the cellulose network, while excessive electrochemical effects at higher field strength produce directional weakening.

falsification_conditions: real samples show no reproducible anisotropy
orientation detected structurally but absent mechanically
mechanical anisotropy is explained by thickness or density gradients
electrode-associated pH or electrolysis effects reproduce the apparent effect without fibril alignment
next_gate: Compare the first real experimental dataset against this SIMULATED reference without modifying the reference retrospectively.
